plan.question: Can fixed trend rules on 4h/daily bars transfer between six assets better than the prior 15m cloud strategy?
plan.rules: Breakout: close beyond previous20/55-bar high/low; exit on previous10/20-bar opposite extreme. Averages: simple moving average20/60 or50/150; first eligible close adopts current regime, later entries/reversals only on regime changes; equality exits. Momentum: close versus30/90 bars ago; same regime rules. Stop then wait for fresh trigger; breakout can retrigger on a new qualifying breakout. No percentage profit protection, no target/trailing stop, no pyramiding.
plan.stops: All12 use Wilder ATR14 x3 fixed absolute initial distance, known at signal close, anchored at actual next-open fill. Never widen after entry. Native-timeframe opposite exit at next open; old initial stop always live intrabar. No new ATR parameter search.
plan.data: Native Binance spot4h/daily candles via project MarketDataService/KlineStore; fetch existing desired start minus200days to fixed end. No manufactured listing history or missing bars. Keep per-request checkpoints; recheck observed internal gaps once. The12 rules use200 observed contiguous warmup bars per slice. Longer full start is the first UTC day on/after old start with sufficient contiguous warmup in BOTH native timeframes. Keep common2021-09→2026-09 only if all six data sets support it; otherwise stop rather than silently shorten.
plan.selection: For each test year2023/2024/2025 (Sep10→Sep10), train from common2021 start to that year. Eligible if strictly positive return on a majority of training assets (4of6 or3of5) and positive median return. Rank eligible by median return, then key. Same global winner applies unchanged to all6; if none passes, cash for that year. Do not rank by win rate or max drawdown.
plan.leave_one_out: Separately for each held asset and each year, use only the other5 assets preceding the test-year boundary to choose by the identical rule. No held-asset return participates in that choice. The chosen rule is tested only on that held asset in the next year. These are transfer diagnostics, not six asset-specific tuning permissions.
plan.lock: Write each chronological fold choice for all6 and each leave-one-out choice BEFORE any new variant next-year evaluation. Existing history was studied before; this does not make it untouched history. After the three folds, evaluate all12 continuously over common5years and each available longer history, and show annual rows. Full-history rank is hindsight only and cannot change earlier choices.
plan.comparison: Old EMA55 parameters unchanged, rerun on identical common and longer periods using original15m snapshots; annual boundary resets match adaptive evaluation. Buy/hold measured from first bar open to last close. Single-asset independent100%-capital accounts; median across assets is not portfolio return. No volatility-based allocation or leverage added.
plan.reporting: Per asset and variant: return, wins/losses/flat, win rate, mean win/loss, holding time, drawdown, both directions, exit reasons, annual equity returns; remove top10 winners as arithmetic sensitivity. Compare each chosen chronological track and leave-one-asset-out track; show performance with best asset omitted. Nearby fast/slow alternatives are shown, not subsequently optimized.
plan.stopping: Exactly12 new configurations. No follow-up tuning after outcomes; preserve all failed versions and every executed trade. No claim that positive history guarantees future profitability or that every year must win. No live orders or automated follow-up.
